long_biography.plain_text:
Investor Yuri Milner co-founded the Breakthrough Prizes and Initiatives to support fundamental science and space research. The prizes recognise advances in physics, life sciences and mathematics, while separate programmes search for technological life and investigate interstellar flight. Milner had previously conducted research in quantum field theory.

After leaving research, Milner studied business at Wharton and worked in the World Bank's financial sector. Convinced that the internet would transform investment, he built Mail.ru Group and founded DST Global to back technology companies across international markets. He remains a partner in DST Global's investment business.
